tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Explore Gather and the relational SDK learning progression.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Create an OCI Free Tier account or use an account you already have, then confirm OCI Console sign-in.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Set up the environment
tutorials.description: Install Docker or Podman, download the stack, configure OCI IAM, enter your environment values, and verify Fusabase console sign-in.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Connect your app
tutorials.description: Create empty tables, register Gather, install the SDK, and paste your configuration to connect automatically.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Authenticate users
tutorials.description: Implement email/password authentication and session changes.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Read and write data
tutorials.description: Create event Grants, save and edit owned events, and share public invitation links.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Query and update related data
tutorials.description: Create own-RSVP Grants and insert, read, and update one response per event.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Secure data access with Grants
tutorials.description: Create the event-access helper and conditional SELECT Grant, then query the permitted guest list.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Upload and retrieve files
tutorials.description: Configure storage Grants, upload an event cover, and retrieve its saved path.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Add Google sign-in
tutorials.description: Optional. Configure Google in the provider consoles and add SDK popup sign-in.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Add GitHub sign-in
tutorials.description: Optional. Configure GitHub OAuth and add SDK popup sign-in, independently of Google.
